item_name: Rothco Deluxe Vintage Canvas Messenger Bag - Olive Drab
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Vintage Unwashed Canvas Messenger Bag Is Designed To Be Your Dependable On The Go Courier.
description: Rothco’s Vintage Unwashed Canvas Messenger Bag Is Designed To Be Your Dependable On The Go Courier.  The Heavyweight Cotton Canvas Messenger Bag’s Features Double Stitched Construction For Long Lasting Durability.  Measuring 15.5" X 11" X 5", The Spacious Main (Lined?) Compartment With Full Zipper Closure Provides Plenty Of Room To Store Books, Folders, A Small Laptop, And Many Other Items. The Main Compartment Features An Additional Small Zippered Pocket (7” X 9”) Two Open Top Front Pockets Located Under Front Flap Closure Allow For Quick And Easy Access To Essential Gear Such As Your Cell Phone. The Bag Is Equipped With Dual Adjustable Brown Canvas Strap Closures With Brass Buckle Hardware. With An Adjustable Padded Brown Canvas Shoulder Strap That Can Extend Up To 52”, You Can Carry Your Military Messenger Bag Across Your Body, Over Your Shoulder, Or In A Variety Of Ways That Best Suits Your Style.
